name: accordion
description: A vertically stacked set of interactive headings that each reveal a section of content.

accordion.purpose: Single accordion item — compose multiple instances at page level.

container.note: Bottom border acts as the separator between stacked items. No fill — transparent.

trigger.note: No horizontal padding — trigger spans full width.

chevronIcon.note: Icon Placeholder — stroke-based. Color bound on VECTOR node strokes, never on instance fill.

content.note: Only present in Open state. No top padding — body text sits flush below trigger.

composition.trigger: FRAME — contains label (TEXT) and chevron (Icon Placeholder INSTANCE)
composition.content: FRAME — present in Open state only, contains content-text (TEXT)
composition.chevron: Icon Placeholder instance — stroke-based; bind color on VECTOR node strokes
composition.pageLevel: Accordion is a single item. Stack multiple instances with itemSpacing=0 to build a full accordion list.

behavior.type: single or multiple — controlled by Radix UI type prop
behavior.collapsible: boolean, default false — when false, an open item cannot be closed by clicking its trigger again
behavior.defaultValue: sets which item opens by default
behavior.disabled: per-item — disabled items cannot be opened or focused
behavior.animation: Radix exposes --radix-accordion-content-height CSS variable for height animation; timing is implementation-defined

accessibility.role: button on trigger, region on content panel
keyboard: Space / Enter — toggle focused item open or closed
Tab / Shift+Tab — move focus between focusable elements
Arrow Down — move focus to next trigger
Arrow Up — move focus to previous trigger
Home — move focus to first trigger
End — move focus to last trigger
accessibility.aria: aria-expanded on trigger, aria-controls linking trigger to content panel

constraints: Accordion is a single item — compose multiple instances at page level with no gap.
Do not set a fill on the accordion container — it is intentionally transparent.
Do not set fills on the chevron instance — bind stroke on the VECTOR node inside.
Trigger has no horizontal padding — do not add padLeft or padRight.
Content body text uses color/text/secondary, not the primary foreground token.
Use type=single for FAQ lists. Use type=multiple when users compare sections.
Set collapsible=true unless a default-open item must always remain visible.
Do not use for primary navigation.

useCases: FAQ pages where users scan question headings and only open relevant answers
Settings panels with multiple grouped sections (Notifications, Privacy, Billing) where users rarely need all groups open at once
Help centre or onboarding documentation that groups topics into collapsible categories
Subscription or pricing pages that reveal plan details on demand without overwhelming the page
Form sections with optional advanced configuration hidden by default
Mobile views where vertical space is constrained and progressive disclosure is essential

Closed.whenToUse: Default resting state — content is hidden, trigger is visible

Open.whenToUse: User has expanded the item to read its content
examples: Active answer on a FAQ page
Expanded billing section in account settings

Disabled.whenToUse: A section is unavailable in the current context (permissions, plan tier, incomplete prerequisite)
examples: Locked plan features on a free tier

comparedTo.situation: Stacked sections where each reveals long-form content, multiple can be open
Mutually exclusive views where only one panel is visible at a time and sections have equal weight
Top-level app navigation with persistent sections
A single disclosure toggle (one item, no stack)

notes: No focus or hover state variants exist in Figma — these are implementation-level CSS states only.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
